title: SFBond 실버폭스 #046 · 바디페인팅(공예 Ukrainian pysanka egg-art linework) · X자 십자틀 + 사지 · Lebanese · early 50s · 헤어 a chin-length bob · 자유축 Core
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 2:3 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a medieval stone dungeon torture chamber with rough-cut stone block walls on each side of her, a low vaulted stone ceiling, iron torch sconces with flickering flames on the walls, old iron tools hanging on the stone wall, a damp flagstone floor, dark and moody firelight, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking in from one side, sharp focus from head to toe, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Subject: ONE real adult Lebanese woman in her early 50s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, radiant glowing bridal makeup, dramatic long lashes, a soft rose lip, warm fair skin, a calm, distant gaze, silver-white hair styled in a chin-length bob, real living eyes. Long coffin nails, glossy finish.

Physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. Huge rounded shoulders and thick, powerfully muscular arms with the swell of the muscle visible beneath a soft layer, a colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in clearly even at this size. Below that waistline a great mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle and drops down under its own weight, gathering into two or three heavy rounded folds, never taut, never smooth, never round like a drum, not pregnant. Enormous round hips more than three times the width of that waistline, colossal thighs with a muscular sweep visible beneath the fat, thick heavy calves. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Skin: Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a smooth taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh folds, faint stretch marks where the great curves have expanded. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Body Art: Her bare skin is painted in Ukrainian pysanka egg-art linework — a deep black ground with fine red, gold and white geometric linework, wide gold-and-red bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs like contour lines, dense geometric wax-resist linework filling the space between every band. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every bulge. The paint covers her body below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of her hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of her feet. Her face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line. A small smudge of soot touches her temple and jaw, with light grime on her fingers and the tops of her bare feet.

Restraints: A heavy wooden saltire cross of two thick rough-hewn dark oak beams crossed in an X and bolted together at the center stands upright behind her, its four arms reaching out to her stretched limbs. Her wrists wear heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron fetters, wide rough-forged iron bands closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, each with a heavy iron ring, each ring hooked directly onto the end of an upper arm of the X, and her ankles wear heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron fetters, wide rough-forged iron bands closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, each with a heavy iron ring, each ring hooked directly onto the end of a lower arm of the X, the cuffs sitting snug against the dark wood, her arms and legs stretched wide apart in the shape of the X. From each of the two wrist cuffs a thick chain hangs down ending in a huge rough-cast black iron ball as big as a bowling ball, the two balls dangling below her hands, and from each of the two ankle cuffs a thick chain runs to a huge rough-cast black iron ball as big as a bowling ball resting on the flagstones beside that foot, the weights pulling every limb down against the cross.

Pose: standing full height with her back against the X-shaped cross, facing the camera, her arms and legs stretched wide apart in a big X with her hands hanging limp and loose from the cuffs, her head tipped slightly forward, her bare feet flat on the flagstones, her whole body sagging a little with fatigue, her chest, shoulders and stomach fully in view.

Footwear: bare feet flat on the flagstones, with a little soot on the soles and toes.

Background & Lighting: dim torchlight and flickering firelight raking across her, catching the painted pattern in sharp glints, carving every fold and curve.

Vertical 2:3 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide. portrait 2:3 vertical.
